args.title: Tamarack Components – "Warehouse automation in 2026" (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Source: Tamarack Components newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026"
(blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse) and its companion piece
(insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion).

- Autonomous carts delivered a real productivity gain: pick rates rose 18% in 2026 deployments.
- The rollout risk is on the integration side, not the robots — integration took roughly twice as long as planned.
- Per the companion piece, the single biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks, so error reduction (not just speed) is where the ROI concentrates.
